Lessons.Title: Heart Rates
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Collect and analyze data using a randomization distribution to compare 2 treatments.

To compare two treatment groups use a randomization distribution of the difference in measured outcomes, checking treatment allocation, group size, and how the comparison statistic is defined. A p-value measures extremeness under a null model, not probability that the null is true.
